mapper.select: SELECT i.*, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, g.unit, g.purchase_price FROM biz_sale_item i INNER JOIN biz_goods g ON i.goods_id = g.id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT c.category_name as name, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) as value FROM biz_sale_item i INNER JOIN biz_sale_order o ON i.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN biz_goods g ON i.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON g.category_id = c.id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status >= 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) FROM biz_sale_item i INNER JOIN biz_sale_order o ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status >= 2 AND DATE(o.ship_time) = #{shipDate}
